Method of Attack: HTML hyperlink auditing ping abuse to perform distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks by programmatically generating and clicking ping links targeting multiple gaming company sites
Use of JavaScript to create HTML ping URLs and automatically click them every second to generate massive web requests
Impacted Systems: Gaming company websites targeted in the DDoS attack
Attack Vector: Social engineering and malvertising to direct users (mainly mobile users using QQBrowser and WeChat default browser) to malicious pages hosting the attack scripts
Malicious advertising injected into legitimate websites posted in large WeChat group chats
Indicators of Compromise: Ping-To and Ping-From headers pointing to http://booc.gz.bcebos.com/yo.js?version=cc000001
Approximately 70 million requests from 4,000 IP addresses over four hours
User-Agent strings associated with QQBrowser and WeChat mobile browser
JavaScript files you.html, ou.js, and yo.js involved in attack execution
